calendar.first_rebalance: first prediction date + 5 sessions (same first date for both arms)
calendar.missing_tickers: a missing name is absent from that date's book; it never shifts the schedule
calendar.not_used: month-end, approximate 4-week jumps, random dates, per-symbol row counts
calendar.schedule: sessions[i0 + k * step_sessions] while the session <= last prediction date
calendar.source: global observed trading calendar (sessions on which any ingested price bar exists), capped at the last prediction date

inputs.prediction_hash_function: EXP-010A _prediction_hash over [date, symbol, fold, fwd_rank_21, prediction] sorted by date, symbol
inputs.regeneration: only if a checkpoint is missing or fails its hash: rerun the unmodified EXP-010A runner; never edit EXP-010A

interpretation.fold_reliance: for every fold f, the seed-median paired net-Sharpe difference recomputed on the pooled periods with fold f removed must stay > 0 when the status is IMPROVED and > -unit when PRESERVED
interpretation.gross_equivalence: absolute median paired gross-Sharpe difference < unit

labels.CADENCE_EQUIVALENT: turnover NOT materially reduced AND net status PRESERVED AND gross equivalent
labels.ECONOMICALLY_IMPROVED: turnover materially reduced AND net status IMPROVED or PRESERVED AND fold-robust
labels.NO_STABLE_ECONOMIC_GAIN: every other outcome, including a gain that depends on a single fold
labels.TURNOVER_REDUCED_SIGNAL_LOST: turnover materially reduced AND net status DEGRADED

net_sharpe_status.IMPROVED: median paired difference >= unit AND at least 9 of 10 seeds positive

interpretation.unit: EXP-010A net-Sharpe seed sample SD (0.081651): a scale for 'material', not a significance test

known_limits: the seed distribution captures model-seed noise only, not date-sampling uncertainty
one phase of the 21-session cycle is evaluated (fixed by the frozen first date); no phase or cadence sweep
B1 has 96 rebalances against 403, so its Sharpe and drawdown are estimated from far fewer, coarser observations
drawdown measured on 21-session periods cannot see the intra-period path
completed-spell holding duration excludes spells still open at the last date

folds.attribution: a rebalance belongs to the fold of the latest frozen prediction date <= it
folds.leave_one_fold_out: pooled paired net Sharpe with one fold removed, per seed

paired.definition: B1 - B0 for the same seed
paired.sign_note: net_max_drawdown is negative, so a positive difference is a shallower drawdown

per_seed_per_arm: average completed holding duration (rebalances and sessions)
gross and net total return and CAGR
top and bottom leg membership retention
effective number of names and maximum weight

no_sweep: exactly two arms; no 10/15/20/22/42-session cadence is run or evaluated

noise_context.use: descriptive context only; no threshold of significance is derived from it

portfolio.engine: EXP-009A engine settings unchanged except the two cadence fields
portfolio.note: the drop budget is per rebalance, so 10% of the book per 21 sessions is a lower per-session churn than per 5

question: Does rebuilding the book every 21 sessions, the horizon the model was trained to rank, improve net economics or reduce turnover relative to the frozen 5-session cadence, using identical predictions and portfolio rules?

signal_alignment.b0_reproduces_exp010a: B0 metrics must equal the committed EXP-010A per-seed metrics to 1e-9 or the run aborts
signal_alignment.eligibility: a name is tradable at t if it is in the point-in-time universe at t, was scored at the latest prediction date <= t, has a signal under the rule above, and has a finite forward return for the arm's horizon
signal_alignment.engine_lag: execution_lag_periods = 0 (the delay is applied by the alignment, identically for both arms)
signal_alignment.rule: the signal for a name at rebalance t is that name's latest frozen prediction dated <= t - 5 sessions (the same one-period, 5-session information delay B0 already has through the engine's lag)
